name: clear
js: (() => { try { localStorage.clear(); } catch (e) {} location.reload(); return true; })()

select-line
js: (() => { window.__pickLine(window.__line); return { section: !!document.querySelector('#inspector .mk-sec'), buttons: [...document.querySelectorAll('#inspector [data-marker]')].map((b) => b.dataset.marker + ':' + b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')).join(','), preview: !!document.querySelector('#inspector .mk-preview') }; })()

name: tick

js: (() => { window.__marker('pill'); const vp = window.__vp(), svg = GMMC.standaloneSvg(GMMC.exportScene()); return { marker: GMMC.lineById(window.__line).marker, pills: vp.querySelectorAll('rect.mk-pill').length, ticks: vp.querySelectorAll('path.mk-tick').length, pillsInExport: (svg.match(/class="mk-pill"/g) || []).length, interchangeRings: vp.querySelectorAll('circle[stroke="#16181D"]').length }; })()

name: zoom-dot

name: unset
js: (() => { window.__marker(''); const l = GMMC.lineById(window.__line); return { marker: l.marker === undefined ? 'unset' : l.marker, mkAny: window.__vp().querySelectorAll('.mk-ring,.mk-tick,.mk-pill,.mk-dot').length }; })()
